seoTitle: Salford Quays Boarding Point — Manchester River Cruises
seoDescription: Where to board at Salford Quays: the Millennium Footbridge boarding point beside MediaCityUK, how to get there by tram or car, parking, arrival times and on-board access.
heading: Salford Quays Boarding Point
intro: Where every cruise begins — under the Millennium Footbridge, between The Lowry and the Quayside Shopping Centre.

sections.heading: Where to board
body: The boarding point is located under the Millennium Footbridge, between The Lowry Theatre and the Quayside Shopping Centre, beside MediaCityUK.

sections.heading: Getting here by car & parking
body: The closest public parking is at the Quayside Shopping Centre, MediaCityUK. Traffic congestion can be severe at weekends, on event days and during peak times — we strongly recommend allowing extra travel time and arriving early.

sections.heading: Arrival & boarding times
body: Please arrive well in advance of your scheduled departure. Our vessels depart promptly and cannot wait for late arrivals, regardless of traffic or parking delays. Boarding typically opens 5–15 minutes before departure.

sections.heading: What to expect
